verdict.rationale: Vue's own docs describe a 'truly reactive, compiler-optimized rendering system that rarely requires manual optimization' (vue-docs-4), and community users independently praise its ergonomic API for declaring reactive component state (vue-comm-2). Together these support the core of the story, but the claim that only dependent code re-runs is implied rather than spelled out. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on reactive state declaration and dependency tracking, and explicit evidence that only the dependent UI code re-runs on change.
